claims.text: The live tree must be a generated snapshot of the repo tree so sha256 equality is the only drift signal.
A Stop-hook warning after the fact cannot make two writable trees structurally identical.
Binding the client rules root to the repository path is the smallest A1-compatible structural fix.

restatements.text: Alice's load-bearing claim is that the live tree must be a generated snapshot of the repo tree, leaving sha256 equality as the only remaining drift signal.
She further claims a Stop-hook warning after the fact cannot make two writable trees structurally identical.

attacks.text: A second writable tree remains an operational hot-patch valve; collapsing roots removes that valve even if sha256 equality would then hold.
